newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish firemen wrestle doomsday prophet off spire.
newsitem.headline: Polish firemen wrestle doomsday prophet off spire.

text.p: Polish firemen struggled for an hour on Friday to save the life of a man who was clinging to a cross atop a church tower and proclaiming the end of the world.
The man scaled the lofty tower in the northern city of Gdynia and prophesied doom to a crowd which gathered in the street below, ignoring pleas to descend, public television news said.
Firemen reached the 27-year-old using a huge extension ladder and managed first to tie the struggling man to the cross for safety, then drag him on to the ladder and lower him down.
"After he was immobilised, an ambulance took the prophet to hospital for observation," the television reported.
The man was named only as Miroslaw T., according to the Polish practice of withholding the surname of people involved in legal proceedings.
